proposals.title: CanonicalEncoder: cycle rejection, plain-object accessor tests, and validated compilation
proposals.why_now: TASK-0005 review-02 returned REQUEST_CHANGES with three MAJOR findings that directly block acceptance: (1) ADR-009 admits plain objects, arrays, and Sets with no acyclic restriction, and the encoder recurses without cycle detection until a native RangeError; the required change is to define cycle semantics in ADR-009 and add active-path detection that never invokes user code; (2) there are no tests for own getter/setter properties on plain objects asserting E_ACCESSOR_DESCRIPTOR with zero getter/setter invocation counts, only the already-passing array accessor tests; (3) the automated validation did not run npm run compile or npm run boundary, leaving strict typecheck and dependency boundary evidence missing from the submission. Until the encoder is accepted, no StateHash, no replay CLI, no CI hash-comparison gate, and no downstream FASE-1 invariant tests can exist.

proposals.title: Electron secure scaffolding, process topology, and minimal CI installer
proposals.why_now: Section 14.6 contains a locked sequencing requirement: the installer must exist in FASE-1 in minimal form; the spec explicitly warns that deferring Electron bootstrap causes ABI and native-module problems to surface too late to fix architecture. INV-29 (contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox:true, named-channel allowlist) is a named FASE-1 acceptance criterion. The process topology (simulation in dedicated worker, renderer presentation-only, typed IPC contract in packages/contracts) is also a FASE-1 gate. This track has no dependency on the encoder or core types and can proceed in parallel, reducing total FASE-1 duration.

proposals.title: Core branded numeric types (ADR-003) and ADR-004 division mode enforcement
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires core completo including integer arithmetic. ADR-003 types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as branded bigint; Tick as branded safe-integer) are fully locked in the spec with no DEFINIR ambiguity, so implementation can proceed without resolving open decisions. ADR-004 enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR and must be resolved and written as an ADR before any domain arithmetic is written; without it, the lint or compile gate on undeclared division is absent and INV-04/INV-05/INV-06/INV-07 cannot be tested. These primitives are direct prerequisites for the ledger, world price generator, and replay CLI. They have no dependency on the CanonicalEncoder.

proposals.title: ADR-002: hash function selection and positional RNG implementation
proposals.why_now: The positional RNG is required for FASE-1 core completion and for the world price generator. ADR-002 specifies that the hash function is DEFINIR with two locked constraints: it must be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR, and it cannot be the language's native hash. The spec recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a as a concrete starting point. Implementing rand() before the ADR is committed would embed unregistered approximation choices that cannot later be changed without invalidating the StateHash of existing saves. This task depends on branded types being present in packages/core to type the inputs and outputs correctly.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo bootstrap (TASK-0002) is the only accepted task: npm workspaces, strict TypeScript, ESLint determinism rules, dependency boundary checker, and CI are in place. All 16 package source files are export{} stubs. CanonicalEncoder has been attempted in TASK-0003, TASK-0004, and TASK-0005 and rejected every time. TASK-0005 review-02 returned REQUEST_CHANGES with three MAJOR findings: cyclic containers cause uncontrolled stack recursion because ADR-009 defines no cycle semantics; required plain-object accessor zero-invocation sentinel tests are absent (distinct from the passing array accessor tests); and the automated validation gate did not independently run npm run compile or npm run boundary. No ADRs have been accepted into docs/decisions/. No Electron scaffolding, installer, core types, RNG, ledger, price generator, replay CLI, or bench tooling exist.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: ADR-009 and CanonicalEncoder remain unaccepted after three task attempts. The spec mandates the encoder and ADR-009 be accepted before any StateHash implementation, blocking the replay CLI, the CI hash-comparison gate, and all FASE-1 invariant tests that depend on state identity. The three MAJOR findings from TASK-0005 review-02 are narrow and precisely specified: define cycle and shared-reference semantics in ADR-009, add cycle detection that never executes user code, add plain-object accessor zero-invocation tests, and supply independently captured output for npm run compile and npm run boundary.

warnings: CanonicalEncoder has been attempted in three successive tasks (TASK-0003, TASK-0004, TASK-0005) and rejected each time. Each rejection introduced new findings beyond those in the prior review. The next attempt (IDEA-001) must address all three TASK-0005 review-02 findings simultaneously and must include captured command output for all four root gates (npm run compile, npm run lint, npm run boundary, npm test). Incremental fixes that resolve two of three findings will be rejected again.

ADR-004 enforcement mechanism (DEFINIR) must be resolved and written as an ADR before any bigint division expression is written in packages/domain or packages/world. Embedding a division implementation without the ADR produces an undeclared rounding-mode decision with economic effect that cannot be changed without invalidating existing save hashes.

The transcendental-function prohibition in §13, combined with the log-space price construction in §5.1, means the fixed-point or lookup-table approach for logPrice must be specified in an ADR before any packages/world price code emits values. Implementing without that ADR would embed unregistered approximation choices that cannot be changed without invalidating the StateHash of all existing reference partidas.

tools/bench calibration ratios must be frozen in FASE-1 per the §18 baseline protocol, but cannot be frozen until packages/world price generation exists. This sequential dependency must not be deferred past FASE-1 acceptance; the bench tool cannot be marked complete without frozen ratios.
